Instrument (EN): Posttraumatic Growth and Depreciation Inventory Expanded — new 2026 Russian caregiver cohort psychometric evidence
Scales / measured domains (EN): Two distinct totals: Posttraumatic Growth (PTG, 25) and Posttraumatic Depreciation (PTD, 25); each five corresponding domains: Relating to others; New possibilities; Personal strength; Spiritual-existential change; Appreciation of life. N404 Russian-speaking unpaid caregivers of patients with chronic psychiatric, neurological and physical illnesses. Confirmatory factor analysis supports growth and depreciation factor models; total alpha PTG .956 / PTD .942, omega .964/.952. Newly indexed INDEPENDENT larger study of previously registered pilot RU edition (2024 N61).
